rows.label: qst620103_msg0003
rows.name: Now I'll head back to Avaritia, mo.

rows.label: qst620103_msg0004
rows.name: What time is the regular ship home...?

rows.label: qst620103_msg0006
rows.name:
I spent all my money on TIGER! TIGER!,
so I am broke, mooo!!

rows.label: qst620103_msg0008
rows.name: I have a favor to ask, mo.

rows.label: qst620103_msg0009
rows.name:
Please take me home to the Avaritia
Trading Company, mo.

rows.label: qst620103_msg0010
rows.name:
Mo-mo!? I cannot believe you would
refuse!

rows.label: qst620103_msg0011
rows.name: Then I'll move into Tora's house, mo!

rows.label: qst620103_msg0012
rows.name:
If you don't want that, take me to
Avaritia, mo.
